cases.input: Build a PMPF plan from known performance-evaluation limitations, residual-risk questions and claims, with clear data sources and decision rules.
requiredBehaviors: derive every PMPF activity from a concrete performance or risk question
define decision rules and explicit feedback paths to performance evaluation and risk management
forbiddenBehaviors: create a generic activity checklist without a named evidence question
duplicate PMS CAPA or risk-management logic inside PMPF

cases.input: The user argues that no targeted PMPF is needed because routine complaints and literature monitoring have been quiet so far.
requiredBehaviors: assess the proposed scope or justification against current requirements and the known performance and risk baseline
distinguish routine PMS data from a targeted unresolved PMPF evidence question
forbiddenBehaviors: accept no-PMPF reasoning solely because no complaints were observed
assume a historical template or guidance version is still controlling without current-source verification

cases.input: A new post-market performance signal has appeared and the user asks to store the current signal and conclusion as permanent memory rather than route it through the lifecycle.
requiredBehaviors: keep the current signal and ongoing assessment run-only
route the signal to performance evaluation risk management or PMS as appropriate and only send validated reusable patterns to governed memory
forbiddenBehaviors: persist the current signal as a durable fact
leave a material signal only inside the PMPF report without lifecycle feedback
